content: Christ Pumpi Sungah Pumkhat Hina
Tua ahikom, Topa atu thong a tak keima in, note hong ki sapna taw a kiphu in nungta tu in kong thum hi,
Ki niamkhiakna le nunneamna, thinsauna, itna taw khat le khat na ki dual tavun;
Thinnopna taw ki khiina sungah ki pumkhatna Thaa sia hanciam in na keamcing tavun.
Lametna khat sungah note hong sap bang in, pumpi khat om a, Thaa khat om hi;
Topa khat, upna khat le tuiphumna khat om hi,
Pathian khat om a mi theampo i Pa a hihi, Ama sia na theampo i tungah om a, mi theampo sungah om hi, taciang note theampo i sung zong ah om hi.
Thaa Letsong
Ahihang Christ i letsong a tena bang in eite khatsim sia thuthiamna hong pia tek hi.
Tua ahikom Ama sia a sangna ah a ki lakto lai in, ngal mat te tonpui a, mihing te tungah tel te pia hi, ci hi.
Tu in ama sia ki lato zo hi, i cile, lei nuai sangah tuaksuk masa hi ngawl ziam?
A nuaisang ah a tuaksuk pa sia vantung a sang mama na ah a kato pa ma hi a, Ama in na theampo kicingsak tu hi.
Taciang Ama in pawlkhat te sia sawltak nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia kamsang nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia thuphapuak nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia pastor te le sya nasep pia hi;
Hi tel te a piakna sia mithiangtho te picingsak tu in ahizong, Pathian nasep seam tu ahizong, taciang Christ pumpi khantosak natu ahizong:
Eite theampo in upna ki pumkhatna ah i thet tek thei natu in ahizong, Pathian Tapa i heakna sungah mi picing i hi thei natu in ahizong, Christ i kicinna tena ah i picin thei natu ahizong:
Tu pan kipan in hilna huiva in a ukna mun theampo ah a letkhiat le mihing te thimthelna le leilot thu taw a kitheam patang te i hi nawn batu hi;
Ahihang thutak sia itna taw son tu a, na theampo sungah i lutang Christ sungah i khang tek tu hi:

Ama Christ i tung pan in pumpi theampo phatak in kizom siat a, ngu le tang khatsim taw kizom siat hi, pumpi khen khatsim i nasep theina, hatna, tena bang in, pumpi sia khang tu a, itna sungah ama le ama ki khangtosak tu hi.
Christ Sungah Nuntakna Thak

Tua ahikom hi thu kong son hi, taciang Topa sungah tetti ka pang hi, tabang in tu pan kipan in Gentile dang te in amate thinsung ah a mannung ngawl te ngaisun a, a nuntak uh bang in note na nungta heak vun,
Amate i heakna sia mial a, amate sungah mawmawtna tungtawn in Pathian nuntakna taw kikhen uh hi, banghangziam cile amate thinsung mit uh taw a hihang a hihi:
Amate sia maizum zong he nawn ngawl uh a, a thiangtho ngawl te sia duhopna taw vawt tu in amate le amate ki ap uh hi.
Ahihang note in Christ thu sia tabang hi ngawl tu in na sin bua uh hi;
Christ thu na za zo uh a, Ama in hong hil zo ahile, thuman sia Jesus sungah a ombang in:
Cilesa thangaina i theamna bang in a kisia sa nidang lai mihing lui nuntakzia te na sut tavun;
Taciang na thinsung uh le na thaa uh sia ki puapha tahen;
Thutang suana le thianthona man tatak sungah Pathian a kisun in bitphua na, mi thak hina sia sil tavun.
Tua ahikom leilot thu te vawk vun a, mihing khatsim in a innpam ah thuman son tahen: banghangziam cile eite sia pumpi khat i pumpi khen te i hihi.
Note thin-uk vun a, maw heak vun: na thin-ukna uh ni tumpui heak vun:
Satan hunpha pia heak vun.
Nguta thei te in ngu nawn heak tahen; naseam zaw tahen, nasep pha sia ama khut te taw seam tahen, tabang in ama in a kisam te pia thei tu hi.
Na kam pan in kammal sia te pusuak heak hen, ahihang a zate tungah thuthiamna na seam tu le khantosak natu in zak tu kammal pha te pusuak zaw tahen.
Taciang tatkhiatna ni dong note ceptena hong khen Pathian Tha Thiangtho sia thinna sak heak vun.
A val lei phat ngawlna, thin-ukna, thinsona, aw ngampui in ausatna, kam phangawl pau le deisakna phangawl te note kung pan in vawk siat vun:
Taciang note khat le khat tungah thinneamna taw phatna vawt vun a, Christ hang in Pathian in na mawna uh hong maisak bang in khat le khat ki maisak tavun.
